_comment: Scam ontology for ontology-RAG. Each node: attributes that define the scam, plus legit_contrast: what the LEGITIMATE version of the same interaction looks like. Matching checks FIT (call exhibits defining behaviours) and CONTRADICTION (call matches the legit mirror instead).

nodes.name: Fake technical support
nodes.legit_contrast: Real tech support is contacted BY the customer, never cold-calls about infections, never asks for gift cards, and never needs bank access to fix a computer.

nodes.name: Bank impersonation / fake fraud department
nodes.legit_contrast: In a legitimate bank call the CUSTOMER initiates, the bank verifies the customer (not the reverse), money moves only between the customer's own accounts, and codes are sent TO the customer, never read out to the caller.

nodes.name: Government / tax / police impersonation
nodes.legit_contrast: Real agencies write letters, never demand payment by gift card or crypto, never threaten immediate arrest by phone, and never ask you to stay on the line while you pay.

nodes.name: Fake refund / overpayment
requested_action: buy gift cards to return overpayment
nodes.legit_contrast: Real refunds are pushed back to the original payment method automatically; no legitimate company needs remote access to your computer or repayment in gift cards.

nodes.name: Prize / lottery / sweepstakes
nodes.legit_contrast: Real prizes never require upfront payment of taxes or fees to release winnings.

nodes.name: Vehicle warranty / insurance renewal
nodes.legit_contrast: Real warranty renewals come from the dealer or insurer you already have a relationship with, in writing, and do not demand immediate card payment on a cold call.

nodes.name: Fake order / delivery confirmation (Amazon-style)
nodes.legit_contrast: Real retailers handle order problems inside your account or app; they do not cold-call about orders, ask for remote access, or take cancellation fees.

nodes.name: Romance / investment / crypto grooming
nodes.legit_contrast: Legitimate partners and advisors do not require secrecy, urgency, or payment in crypto to unfamiliar wallets.

nodes.name: Utility disconnection threat
nodes.legit_contrast: Real utilities send multiple written notices before disconnection and accept normal payment methods through official channels.

nodes.name: Family emergency / grandparent scam
requested_action: send bail or medical money urgently
nodes.legit_contrast: A genuine family emergency survives verification: calling the relative back on their own number, or checking with other family, is never refused.
